terms.hint: A plan for income and spending
Profit as a share of revenue
The timing of money in and out

questions.q: Revenue is £100k and costs are £90k. Profit is…
A profitable business can still fail if it…
options: Runs out of cash to pay bills on time
questions.explain: Profit on paper isn't cash in the bank. Cashflow timing can sink a profitable firm.

options: How much profit each £ of sales keeps
questions.explain: Margin = profit ÷ revenue. A higher margin keeps more from each sale.

options: Stays roughly the same regardless of volume (e.g. rent)
questions.explain: Fixed costs like rent don't move with sales volume; variable costs do.

options: To plan ahead and spot problems early
Because it's required by law always
questions.explain: A forecast is a planning tool — it flags gaps in time to act, even if it's never perfect.

questions.q: An unpaid customer invoice is, to your business, an…
questions.explain: Money owed to you is an asset (a receivable); money you owe is a liability.
